name: Guadalupe Mountains National Park
summary: The roof of Texas — an ancient fossil reef rising from the desert, the state's highest peak, and a canyon that blazes with fall color. The last stop before New Mexico.

lodging.name: Camp in the park or stay in Carlsbad, NM
lodging.blurb: Remote — the nearest beds are over the New Mexico line.

foodMustTry.name: Pack your own
foodMustTry.blurb: No services in the park — bring food and water.

days.label: Day 353 — The Roof of Texas
days.summary: A fossil reef and the highest peak.

item.title: McKittrick Canyon & Guadalupe Peak

location.name: Guadalupe Mountains National Park
location.address: 400 Pine Canyon Dr, Salt Flat, TX

item.blurb: Hike McKittrick Canyon (stunning fall color) beneath El Capitan, or summit Guadalupe Peak — the highest point in Texas at 8,751 ft.

days.label: Day 354 — Into New Mexico
days.summary: North to the caverns — Texas is done.

commute.scenicNote: North across the line into New Mexico and the Desert Southwest.
